operator_notes: Download Latest Bulletin button on #sbp-bulletin section.
Parish website may lag — if bulletin date is months old, ask parish to update the button link.
operator_notes_2026_08_09: FIX: download step had use_captured_url:true pinned to the March 2025
trained PDF. replay.py's click-step peek-ahead sees use_captured_url
and downloads that exact old URL via plain HTTP BEFORE ever running
the click — so the recipe silently froze on a 2025 bulletin forever
while still reporting outcome=ok. Removed use_captured_url + the
stale url so the click step's pick_strategy:newest_dated actually runs.
NOTE: as of 2026-08-09 the parish's own 'Download Latest Bulletin'
button on the site still points at the March 2025 PDF (confirmed via
direct HTML fetch) — the site itself has not been updated in ~17
months. This fix stops the harvester from being MORE stale than the
site, but the parish needs to update their own bulletin widget for
this to ever show a current bulletin.
